spec_match.rationale: Sweeps the four real keywords plus a non-standard name through a live frame tree and reads where each navigation landed — the exact contract of the removal.

interactive.rationale: Sweep and reset drive real iframe navigations; results table filled from the live tree (verified; the transient ERR_ABORTED entries during the sweep are the in-flight iframe documents being navigated away, not failures of the page).

blurb_alignment.rationale: The difference stops being a claim and becomes watchable, as promised.

edge_cases.rationale: Covers resolutions that need no navigation and the case-sensitivity trap.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Sweep executed; frames moved as the standard specifies on this build; console clean apart from expected aborted subresource loads inside navigated-away iframes.

telemetry_health.rationale: Assert conditions are event-style; a falsifiable check (every keyword landed where the table claims) would catch regressions.

accessibility.rationale: Buttons and tables are fine, but 7 of 12 tab stops landed inside iframes where focus visibility could not be confirmed from outside; the page's own controls all show focus.

conformance.rationale: Feature suite passes 4/4 on this build — the removal has shipped here, so _current resolves as an ordinary name.

design_system.rationale: Variables throughout; secondary buttons override both background and color.

openQuestions.title: Confirm keyboard focus remains visible across the embedded frames
openQuestions.detail: Tabbing through the page enters the three demo iframes; from the outer document the focus indicator inside them cannot be verified headlessly. Manually confirm the iframe documents keep a visible focus style (they load the shared stylesheet, so this is likely fine) and note it in the page or this critique.

summary: Verified on headless Chromium 153 (Chrome for Testing 153.0.8010.12) driven over CDP via a Playwright script — chrome-devtools-mcp is unavailable in this cloud environment; desktop 1280×800 and mobile 360×740 DPR3 screenshots captured and inspected. Real frame-tree navigation evidence; the removal is live on this 153 build and the sweep shows standard behaviour.
